access to resources, motivation level, peer influence, distance from home, learning disabilities
teacher quality, parental involvement
```{r}
library(readr)
StudentPerformance <- read.csv("StudentPerformanceFactors.csv")
Perf <- StudentPerformance %>% select(Exam_Score, Hours_Studied, Attendance, Parental_Involvement, Extracurricular_Activities, Sleep_Hours, Internet_Access, Tutoring_Sessions, Family_Income, School_Type, Physical_Activity, Parental_Education_Level, Gender, Teacher_Quality, Previous_Scores)
mod <- lm(Exam_Score ~., Perf)
summary(mod)
plot(mod, 1)
plot(mod, 2)
```


```{r}
summary(StudentPerformance)
min(StudentPerformance$Exam_Score)

```


```{r}
all <- lm(Exam_Score ~., StudentPerformance)
summary(all)
VIF(all)

library(ggplot2)


# Step 5: Create a histogram for the Exam_Score column
ggplot(StudentPerformance, aes(x = Exam_Score)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "red", color = "black") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of Exam Scores",
    x = "Exam Score",
    y = "# of Students"
  )

ggplot(StudentPerformance, aes(x = Exam_Score)) +
  geom_density(fill = "orange", color = "black") + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram of Exam Scores",
    x = "Exam Score",
    y = "Probability Density"
  )
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse) 
library(regclass) 
StudentPerformance <- read.csv("StudentPerformanceFactors.csv")
Perf <- StudentPerformance %>% select(Exam_Score, Hours_Studied, Attendance, Extracurricular_Activities, Sleep_Hours, Internet_Access, Tutoring_Sessions, Family_Income, Teacher_Quality, School_Type, Physical_Activity, Parental_Education_Level, Parental_Involvement, Gender, Previous_Scores) 
modbase <- lm(Exam_Score ~ ., Perf) 
summary(modbase)
```
